sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pat(fr, r0, c0):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return ''.join(''.join('#' if ch=='B' else '.' for ch in a[r][c0:c0+5]) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def h8(fr, r0, c0):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        if n['color']=='B' and min(rs)==r0 and min(cs)==c0: return n['hash'][:8]
    return '----'
seq=[]
start=h8(current_frame,52,15)
seq.append((start, pat(current_frame,52,15)))
for i in range(12):
    action(['UP'])
    h=h8(current_frame,52,15)
    seq.append((h, pat(current_frame,52,15)))
    if h==start and i>0: break
print('cycle len:', len(seq)-1)
for h,p in seq: print(h, p)
print('--- S tape shapes ---')
for i,c in enumerate([15,22,29,36,43]): print('S%d'%i, pat(current_frame,41,c))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def pat(fr, r0, c0):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return ''.join(''.join('#' if ch=='B' else '.' for ch in a[r][c0:c0+5]) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def h8(fr, r0, c0):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        if n['color']=='B' and min(rs)==r0 and min(cs)==c0: return n['hash'][:8]
    return '----'
